mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate profitability, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the triggered instances, or the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within a month signals a weakening labor market, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the triggered instances, or the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in retail sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals a weakening consumer demand, which reduces corporate revenues and earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the triggered instances, or the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals a strengthening supply side, which boosts corporate earnings and investor sentiment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the triggered instances, or the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4.5% and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 in a month, it signals a tight labor market with wage pressure, which increases inflation expectations and reduces real returns, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 4.5% and PAYEMS increases > 200,000 in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the triggered instances, or the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) decline by more than 10% year-over-year and consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 2% year-over-year, it signals a demand-side slowdown coupled with inflationary pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST declines > 10% YoY and CPIAUCSL increases > 2% YoY
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the triggered instances, or the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 1% for more than 6 consecutive months signals a prolonged accommodative monetary policy, which boosts equity valuations and investor sentiment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the triggered instances, or the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An always-on signal where a positive year-over-year growth in real GDP (GDPC1) indicates a healthy economic expansion, which supports corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances, or the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.
